headline: BNP's Sarowar Alamgir takes oath as MP for Chattogram-2
summary: Following a government gazette notification, the BNP candidate has officially been sworn in as a Member of Parliament.
details: Sarowar Alamgir, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) candidate for the Chattogram-2 constituency, has officially taken his oath as a Member of Parliament.
The swearing-in ceremony follows the publication of a government gazette notification declaring him as the elected representative for the seat.
The event marks a formal transition for the BNP leader to assume his legislative duties in the National Parliament.
Earlier, there were reports of communications sent to the Election Commission regarding the necessity of a court order copy before the oath-taking process could proceed.
caption:
A new face enters Parliament. BNP's Sarowar Alamgir officially takes the oath for Chattogram-2.

Sarowar Alamgir, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) candidate for the Chattogram-2 constituency, has officially taken his oath as a Member of Parliament.

The swearing-in ceremony follows the publication of a government gazette notification declaring him as the elected representative for the seat.

The event marks a formal transition for the BNP leader to assume his legislative duties in the National Parliament.

Earlier, there were reports of communications sent to the Election Commission regarding the necessity of a court order copy before the oath-taking process could proceed.

#Bangladesh #Politics #BNP #Chattogram #Parliament #News

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune

headline: Two Bangladeshis shot dead in South Africa
summary: The victims, hailing from Noakhali, have left their families and hometown in mourning.
details: Two Bangladeshi nationals were shot and killed in South Africa.
The victims were originally from the Noakhali district of Bangladesh.
The news of their deaths has cast a shadow of grief and mourning across their hometown in Noakhali.
Further details regarding the circumstances of the shooting are awaited.
